items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Noon is Edward Johnson too... And then you joined the Camellia you say with Wooden Joe? [INTERVIEWEE] I joined the Camellia band, that's right.

ctx.x: One is Eddie and one is Edward.
Oh I see. Well Noon is Edward Johnson too, you know. And that's Noon's real name, you know. That really does get confused in there. And then you joined the Camellia you say with Wooden Joe?
I joined the Camellia band, that's right.
